Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission of the City and County of San Francisco, March 19, 1987
sources.label: Recreation and Park Commission minutes, San Francisco Public Library (Internet Archive)

historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $2.6 million master plan for Buena Vista Park, drawn up through community meetings, centered on replanting the park's very old trees, erosion control and signs, with later renovation of the tennis courts; a $163,972 automatic irrigation system had been let to Munkdale Bros. in February.
